'''''Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]]. It is the second installment of the series ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'', and it marks the first appearance of [[Xanatos]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] fallen [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. The book was published in [[May]] [[1999]] by [[Scholastic]].
